name: Run Smart Campaign (request)
summary: Sends a set of leads through a trigger campaign's flow right now.
whenToUse: When you want to run a 'Campaign is Requested' campaign against specific people via the API.
confirm: This sends the listed leads through the campaign's flow right now (up to 100 per call). Continue?

path.name: id
path.label: Campaign ID
path.hint: The campaign's ID (from List Smart Campaigns — the campaign's id, not its smart list's).

body.hint: Lead IDs (from the Leads calls). Marketo accepts at most 100 per call.

response.description: Confirmation that the request was accepted.

notes: The campaign must have a 'Campaign is Requested' trigger with Web Service API as the source, and must be active.
Token overrides (My Tokens) are not exposed in this form — see the Marketo docs if you need them.
